data.body: Exact-SHA review of 3a504670654d1507d6bbc4f3dc02e808a77454f4 found one blocking documentation-accuracy defect after all 24 blocks were inspected: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_split_jql_queries.py:6 claims the tests assert cross-query deduplication, but the only tests cover ordering, Done cap, and active uncapped behavior, and the fixture emits disjoint ACT/DONE-prefixed keys. Structural guard, scoped Ruff/format, hygiene, diff integrity, and 26 focused tests pass; candidate remains clean and immutable. Per ticket protocol, no 24-row PASS receipt will be issued until an amended SHA removes or corrects the unsupported claim.
